Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 2027 of 2022
Rehan ........Applicant
 Versus

Present:-
 Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate for the applicant.
 Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant Rehan is in judicial custody in FIR/Case Crime No. 32 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366-A
& 376 Ipc and Section 5(l)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police
Station Raiwala, District Dehradun.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant had enticed the victim, a young girl of 16 years of age.
The victim was subsequently recovered from the applicant.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is 19 years of age; he was in romantic relationship with the victim; the victim has so admitted in her statement recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("the Code") soon after her recovery.

Though the learned counsel for the applicant admits that in her statements recorded under Section 164 of the Code and in the trial, the victim has improvised her statement so as to implicate the applicant.

Learned counsel for the applicant would further submit that the victim has written that she was in love with the applicant and she wanted to marry him, but because of different religion, married could not take place.
5. These facts are admitted by the learned State Counsel.
6. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion is not expected of.
The discussion is being made with a caveat that any observation made in this order should not have any bearing at trial.
7. The victim in her initial statement during investigation has stated that she was in romantic relationship with the applicant and they wanted to marry each other.

In her cross-examination in the court also, the victim has proved some documents, where she has written that she was in love Rehan vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152990134/

sentences.text: 9. Having considered, this Court is of the view that subject to certain conditions, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

11. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant or any of his relatives shall not make any contact with the victim, in any manner, whatsoever, either physically, electronically or by any other means.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to Court or any Police Officer and the applicant should not tamper with evidence.
(Ravindra Maithani, J) 13.08.2024 Avneet/
